title: 1:1 — Vishesh & Priya
description: Weekly 1:1: wins, growth areas, and the design review.
transcript: 00:03 Vishesh Gupta: Hey Priya, how's your week been? Let's do the usual — wins, growth areas, then logistics.
00:12 Priya Sharma: It's been a good week, honestly. The two-panel Notepad layout is done in Figma, and I think it's the best work the team has shipped this year.
00:26 Vishesh Gupta: I agree — the review feedback was overwhelmingly positive. People especially loved the collapsible icon rail.
00:36 Priya Sharma: That was actually the hardest part. It took three iterations to get the collapse behavior feeling right.
00:44 Vishesh Gupta: Tell me about the iterations — what changed?

00:49 Priya Sharma: The first version was a drawer, which felt heavy. The second had the icons jumping around when it collapsed. The third one — the one we shipped — keeps the icons in a fixed rail so your muscle memory doesn't break.
01:07 Vishesh Gupta: That attention to detail is exactly what we need more of. I want you to present this at the October 21st leadership review.
01:17 Priya Sharma: Really? That's a little outside my comfort zone, but I'd love to.
01:23 Vishesh Gupta: You'll be great. We'll prep together — how about we do a dry run on the 20th?
01:29 Priya Sharma: Let's do it. I'll prepare the deck this week and share it by Thursday.
01:36 Vishesh Gupta: Perfect. How are things otherwise — anything blocking you?
01:41 Priya Sharma: Two things. First, I'm still waiting on the accessibility audit for the dark theme — I asked for it two weeks ago and it's stuck with the vendor.
01:54 Vishesh Gupta: That's on me — I'll chase them today and get you a date before end of week.
02:01 Priya Sharma: Thank you. Second, the mobile app designs are lagging because we deprioritized them for the Notepad work. I'm worried we're building up a design debt balloon.
02:15 Vishesh Gupta: I hear you. Let's scope mobile properly at the kickoff for the next sprint — I don't want it bolted on later.
02:25 Priya Sharma: That's all I ask. Can we put 30 minutes on the calendar for it next Monday?
02:31 Vishesh Gupta: Yes, I'll book it today — Monday at 3pm.
02:36 Priya Sharma: Great. On growth areas, I'd love feedback on how I handled the sprint planning session last week.
02:44 Vishesh Gupta: Honestly, it was strong. One thing — you went quiet when Arjun pushed back on the timeline. In planning sessions, push back visibly, not just in the doc afterwards.
02:58 Priya Sharma: That's fair. I knew I disagreed in the room but I second-guessed myself. I'll work on it — maybe I'll script my pushbacks before the next session.
03:11 Vishesh Gupta: Small thing, big impact. Okay — anything you need from me, or from the company?
03:18 Priya Sharma: The team asked about the hack week in December. Is that still happening?
03:24 Vishesh Gupta: It's still on — I'll confirm the dates by next Friday. I know people are excited about it.
03:33 Priya Sharma: People are definitely excited. Okay, that's everything from me.

03:38 Vishesh Gupta: Great session. To recap — you prep the deck by Thursday, we dry run on the 20th, I chase the audit vendor today, book mobile scoping Monday, and confirm hack week dates by Friday.
03:56 Priya Sharma: Sounds like a plan. Thanks, Vishesh!

summary.overview: Weekly 1:1. Wins: the two-panel Notepad layout shipped after three iterations on the collapsible icon rail, receiving strongly positive review feedback. Priya will present it at the October 21st leadership review, with a dry run on the 20th. Blockers: the accessibility audit is stuck with the vendor (Vishesh chasing today), and mobile designs are accumulating debt — scoping session booked Monday 3pm. Growth area: visible pushback in planning sessions.
